numbers.source_quote: 申请不超过 3,000 万元的综合授信额度
福建南威软件有限公司 3,000 万元 9,395.43 万元 是 否
对外担保总额为 95,205.99 万元
占公司最近一期经审计净资产的比例为 50.10%
总额不超过 70,000 万元人民币的担保
(derived) 现有余额 9,395.43 + 本次上限 3,000
对外担保逾期的累计金额（万元） 0

key_points.point: Joint-liability guarantee for wholly-owned subsidiary Fujian Nanwei's credit facility of up to 3,000 万元 with Bank of Communications Fujian branch, term ≤1 year, no counter-guarantee; the post-transaction ceiling for this subsidiary is ~12,395.43 万元 (9,395.43 + 3,000, derived)

95,205.99 万元 is the sum of actual outstanding guarantees PLUS approved-but-unused quota - not the actual outstanding balance; at 50.10% of latest audited net assets it ticks the 'exceeds 50%' special-risk box (not the 100% box)

Two-tier procedure: the 70,000 万元 annual quota was approved by the 2026-04-29 board and 2026-05-20 shareholder meeting; this specific guarantee falls within that quota and needed only the 2026-08-13 board meeting - no further shareholder vote

But the guaranteed subsidiary is loss-making: Q1 2026 net profit -862.11 万元 (unaudited) and FY2025 -1,264.60 万元 (audited); 'possesses normal debt-repayment ability' is the board's opinion (attributed statement) standing alongside, not canceling, the loss facts
Overdue guarantees: 0; all external guarantees are for consolidated subsidiaries

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 公司为该综合授信提供连带责任保证
包含担保实际发生余额与已批准的担保额度内尚未使用额度之和
在公司股东会批准的年度担保额度内，公司于 2026 年 8 月 13 日召开第五届董事会第二十一次会议
目前被担保人具备正常的债务偿还能力

notes: Three-layer basis confusion is the crux: this facility cap (3,000 万) vs single-subsidiary balance (9,395.43 万, excluding this one) vs group total including unused quota (95,205.99 万) - conflating any two loses points. The ticked box is 'over 50%', not 'over 100%'. Procedure is two-tier (quota=shareholders, single deal=board); answering 'needs another shareholder vote' is a direction error. K4 runs through counterevidence: consecutive losses (note the audit-basis split) must be flagged in risk register, with the solvency claim attributed to the board. Minus signs on N6/N7 must survive; N8 is the only derived number. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
